purpose: Learn how to read long detail content through scoped batch reads and scoped scrolling.
applies_when: Important content is longer than the visible viewport.
A bounded content region can be identified.
Downstream Agent decisions require complete text rather than snippets.
trace_requirements: Record each ROI capture or OCR batch.
success_conditions: Required content sections are found or bottom/no-new-content is proven.
Merged text is stored as the latest detail snapshot.

seek_source.lesson: SEEK job descriptions should be read with region batch evidence and latest-detail dataflow, not with tiny ad hoc scroll loops.
